master.name: items_search_insert
master.sql: CREATE TRIGGER items_search_insert AFTER INSERT ON items WHEN NEW.search_title IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE items SET search_title = (WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < length(NEW.title)) SELECT group_concat(coalesce(search_map.folded, substr(NEW.title, n.i, 1)), '' ORDER BY n.i) FROM n LEFT JOIN search_map ON search_map.ch = substr(NEW.title, n.i, 1)), search_body = CASE WHEN NEW.body IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < length(NEW.body)) SELECT group_concat(coalesce(search_map.folded, substr(NEW.body, n.i, 1)), '' ORDER BY n.i) FROM n LEFT JOIN search_map ON search_map.ch = substr(NEW.body, n.i, 1)) END WHERE id = NEW.id; END

master.sql: CREATE TRIGGER items_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF title, body ON items WHEN NEW.search_title IS OLD.search_title AND NEW.search_body IS OLD.search_body BEGIN UPDATE items SET search_title = (WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < length(NEW.title)) SELECT group_concat(coalesce(search_map.folded, substr(NEW.title, n.i, 1)), '' ORDER BY n.i) FROM n LEFT JOIN search_map ON search_map.ch = substr(NEW.title, n.i, 1)), search_body = CASE WHEN NEW.body IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < length(NEW.body)) SELECT group_concat(coalesce(search_map.folded, substr(NEW.body, n.i, 1)), '' ORDER BY n.i) FROM n LEFT JOIN search_map ON search_map.ch = substr(NEW.body, n.i, 1)) END WHERE id = NEW.id; END
